facts.text: Andrew and Audrey are looking forward to a hike where their pets, Toby and Audrey's pups, will meet.

evidence.quote: Can't wait for our hike - and for Toby and your pups to meet!
Can't wait either! It's going to be loads of fun and a great memory.

facts.text: Audrey made pet tags with a lot of love, intending for her pets to feel seen and loved.

evidence.quote: I did put a lot of love into making these tags. I want my pets to feel seen and loved.

facts.text: Andrew and Audrey both acknowledge that small acts of love, like making pet tags, make a big difference in their relationships with their pets.

evidence.quote: It really are the small things like these show we care a ton about out pets.
Small acts of love like that make a big difference in our relationships with our furry pals.
